acceptance.rationale: scripts/codex_result_carrier.py publishes base and result trees as two parentless evidence commits under refs/evidence/codex-v2/<id>/{base,result} and packs them into a bundle with a sidecar manifest; receipt data/handoff/codex-v2/issue-508-result-carrier-receipt.json records required_outcomes.durable_result_carrier PASS for implementation commit 243635885f7bcff64c606dffe7fcbe09ada9c5b2

worker result v2 carries executor_provenance (adapter version/blob digest, codex binary identity and SHA-256, runtime/model/config identity, sandbox/approval policy), recomputed from the adapter and binary on disk by scripts/check_codex_worker_result.py; a signed-in session is explicitly not recorded as executable provenance

references/contracts/codex-worker-result-v2.schema.json (Draft 2020-12, additionalProperties false, schema_version pinned to 2) owns the shape; scripts/check_codex_worker_result.py owns the semantics and compile_codex_live_acceptance.py consumes it instead of defining the shape in code

codex_result_carrier.py replay resolves the result tree from bundle + manifest alone in a bare scratch repository created outside the originating repository with inherited GIT_DIR/alternates variables stripped; controls C1-C4 in tests/codex_result_carrier_selftest.py prove the checker goes RED_FOR_REASON when the tree survives only in the originating object store

the deterministic lane is the ceiling this issue reached; skills/agentic-tech-lead-orchestration/runtime-handoff/README.md records 'fresh Codex v2 live acceptance NOT_EXERCISED / #464' and states the Codex queue stops at #508 because #508 changes the subject #464 must bind; #464 is OPEN
